Broccoli Burgers
By: Andie Mitchell
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 6:32am

Ingredients




1 pound Ground round steak
1/2 cup broccoli, cooked and finely chopped
1 teaspoon Dried thyme
4 slices cheese
(Swiss, Cheddar, or other favorite)

Preparation

1 Preheat grill or broiler on high heat. 2 In a medium bowl, combine beef, broccoli, and thyme. 3 Form beef mixture into 4 patties. 4 Cook until desired doneness. 5 Place cheese on top of meat patties just before done. Cook for 30 seconds more, or until cheese melts.

About


Everyone loves hamburgers! These burgers are laced with broccoli and can be made miniature and served on small, whole-grain rolls.
